newsitem.title: INDIA: India CRISIL assigns "P1+" rating to AEC.
newsitem.headline: India CRISIL assigns "P1+" rating to AEC.

text.p: India's Credit Rating Information Services of India Ltd (CRISIL) said on Wednesday it had assigned a "P1+" rating to the 300-million-rupee commercial paper programme of The Ahmedabad Electricity Co. Ltd. (AEC).
The rating indicates that the degree of safety regarding the timely payment on the instrument is very strong, CRISIL said in a statement.
AEC is a utility company engaged in the generation and distribution of electrical power in Ahmedabad and Gandhinagar cities in the western state of Gujarat, covering an area of around 356 square kms.

CRISIL said the electricity generation of AEC during the year 1996/97 was around 3134 million units, an increase of around 7 percent over the previous year, which can be attributed primarily to increased fuel availability of the Vatava plant after conversion to dual firing system and higher exports to Gujarat Electricity Board (GEB) during non-peak hours.
